author_or_account: UN Office for Digital and Emerging Technologies
title: Safe and inclusive digital public infrastructure
discussion_signal: The post presents inclusive digital public infrastructure as a governance problem involving interoperability, digital public goods, verifiable credentials, and proactive services, not technology alone. This supplies a direct institutional signal for examining whether infrastructure expands women’s access or reproduces exclusion.
linked_research_question: What design, governance, and accountability conditions make digital public infrastructure accessible and safe across gendered patterns of exclusion?
limits: No gender-disaggregated user evidence is presented
Stated principles do not demonstrate implementation outcomes
